query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing challenges with particle separation in our hydrocyclone. Can you help me optimize the cut diameter by analyzing the impact of inlet velocity and density differentials?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Optimize the cut diameter of a hydrocyclone by analyzing the effect of inlet velocity and density differentials on particle separation efficiency.

clarification_questions: What are the current cut diameter and separation efficiency of the hydrocyclone?
What is the particle size distribution and density of the feed stream?
Are there any constraints on the inlet velocity or equipment modifications?
